changes.title: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL announces Extended Support minor versions 13.23-rds.20260819, 12.22-rds.20260820 and 11.22-rds.20260822
changes.detail: Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) for PostgreSQL announces Amazon RDS Extended Support minor versions 13.23-rds.20260819, 12.22-rds.20260820 and 11.22-rds.20260822. Amazon RDS Extended Support provides up to three additional years of fixes for critical Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) and bugs beyond a major version's end of standard support date, giving you more time to upgrade to a new major version. changes.title: Amazon RDS for MySQL 26.10 is now available in Amazon RDS Database Preview Environment
changes.detail: Starting today, Amazon RDS for MySQL 26.10 is available in the Amazon RDS Database Preview Environment , allowing you to evaluate the pre-release of MySQL 26.10 on Amazon RDS for MySQL. MySQL 26.10 includes bug fixes, security patches, and some improvements to READ COMMITTED workload performance and purge lag warnings in the error log. On busy READ COMMITTED workloads, NUMA systems performance could be impacted as each read view that closed required a global mutex.
